entries.description: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, and neural network technologies.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Content focused on AI/ML models, algorithms, training, research, or societal impact.
entries.exclusion_criteria: General software engineering without AI/ML components.

entries.description: Running machine learning and large language models on local consumer hardware.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Discussions of Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, local quantization, on-device inference, or offline AI workflows.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Cloud-only API hosted models without local inference context.

entries.description: Autonomous or semi-autonomous LLM-driven agents and tool-calling systems.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Agent frameworks, function calling, multi-agent workflows, autonomous coding agents, or planning loops.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Simple single-prompt chatbots without agency or tools.

entries.description: Diffusion models, GANs, and visual generative AI tools.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Stable Diffusion, Flux, Midjourney, ComfyUI, image generation benchmarks or techniques.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Non-generative computer vision (e.g., optical character recognition).

entries.description: Software development, programming languages, and implementation techniques.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Source code examples, architecture discussions, refactoring, algorithms, and design patterns.

entries.description: Compilers, package managers, IDEs, terminals, and workflow utilities.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Tools like uv, Git, Docker, editors, CLI frameworks, and build systems.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Consumer software unrelated to software engineering.

entries.description: Apple Silicon architecture, unified memory, Metal, and performance benchmarks.
entries.inclusion_criteria: M-series chips, unified memory bandwidth, MLX optimization, Apple Silicon performance comparisons.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Generic x86 or Intel hardware discussions.

entries.description: Data privacy, encryption, local-first computing, and data sovereignty.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Local data storage, telemetry blocking, privacy regulations, self-hosting for privacy reasons.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Public broadcasting and unencrypted data transmission.

entries.description: Essay composition, technical writing, thought structure, and knowledge organization.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Writing workflows, outlining methods, prose style, research synthesis, and creative output.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Casual social chatter with no writing craft focus.

entries.description: Electric power generation, transmission, regional grids (PJM, ERCOT), and utility rate dynamics.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Power grid reliability, electricity rates, data center power demands, substations, energy regulation, and capacity constraints.
entries.exclusion_criteria: General environmental essays without energy infrastructure or utility focus.

entries.description: Economic policy, utility regulation, public finance, subsidies, and municipal fiscal impacts.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Public utility commissions, commercial tax abatements, municipal revenue, tariff design, economic policy debates, and regulatory capture.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Generic corporate earnings reports without policy or public finance relevance.

entries.description: Austrian economics, spontaneous order, business cycle theory, sound money, and market processes.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Mises, Hayek, Rothbard, monetary debasement, capital theory, Austrian business cycle theory, price signals, and subjective value.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Standard Keynesian monetary stimulus proposals lacking Austrian economic critique.

entries.description: Bitcoin, hard money, proof-of-work, peer-to-peer electronic cash, and cryptographic protocols.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Bitcoin mining, UTXO architecture, Lightning network, self-custody, monetary properties of BTC, cryptographic proofs, and decentralization.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Speculative memecoins or centralized crypto token promotions.

entries.description: Operating systems, low-level systems programming, kernels, memory management, and Unix architecture.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Linux/BSD kernels, OS architecture, POSIX APIs, memory allocators, filesystems, eBPF, compilers, hardware interfacing, and system calls.
entries.exclusion_criteria: High-level web frontend development or casual consumer app reviews.

entries.description: Video games, game engines, game mechanics design, retro gaming, and interactive simulations.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Game architecture, graphics engines, physics, retro hardware, game design theory, procedural generation, and playable tech demos.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Gambling or pure esports tournament match scoreboards.

entries.description: Philosophy, epistemology, ethics, philosophy of mind, rationality, and history of ideas.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Epistemological inquiry, moral philosophy, consciousness, rationalist thought, logic, cognitive philosophy, and intellectual history.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Casual inspirational self-help quotes lacking philosophical argumentation.

entries.description: Political commentary, civic governance, institutional critique, political economy, and societal debates.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Institutional analysis, civic debates, political commentary, freedom of expression, state capacity, governance structures, and societal trends.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Transient daily election horse-race polling with no lasting analytical substance.

entries.description: Creative technology, novel computational art, ingenious experiments, interactive hacks, and cool demos.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Generative art, novel UI experiments, demoscene, hardware hacks, delightful computational curiosities, and creative AI mashups.
